_notes: Razorfen Kraul boss + named-rare loot (2026-10-21). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make).

Roogug.name: Roogug's Vine-Cutter
Roogug.flavor_text: A hooked axe made for cutting thorn and, when thorn is not available, other things.

Roogug.name: Thornhide Bracers
Roogug.flavor_text: Leather wrapped over a brace of dried thorn. Every pull of the strap draws a little blood.

Roogug.name: Boarhide War-Belt
Roogug.flavor_text: A broad belt of boar-skin and iron studs. It smells, honestly, of boar.

Roogug.name: Bridgewalker's Mantle
Roogug.flavor_text: A cloak of woven vine and wool. It sways, even when you do not.

Roogug.name: Kraul Rootkeeper's Tally
Roogug.flavor_text: Counts of a harvest nobody ate.
Roogug.label: Tome (Int)

Aggem Thorncurse.name: Thorncursed Mantle
Aggem Thorncurse.flavor_text: Spun from briar-fibre and hexed twice. It whispers in a boar's voice, which is unsettling.

Aggem Thorncurse.name: Aggem's Gnarled Staff
Aggem Thorncurse.flavor_text: A knot of ironwood with a boar's tusk at the head. It remembers the herd.

Aggem Thorncurse.name: Spiritbound Greaves
Aggem Thorncurse.flavor_text: Mail boots lined with something warm that is not fur. They keep their footing on any hill.

Aggem Thorncurse.name: Thorncurse Signet
Aggem Thorncurse.flavor_text: A ring of braided thorn. Wounds nearby close a little faster, and a little reluctantly.

Death Speaker Jargba.name: Death Speaker's Cowl
Death Speaker Jargba.flavor_text: A cowl stitched from burial shrouds. The dead are very chatty, if you are the one wearing it.

Death Speaker Jargba.name: Mind-Bound Wand
Death Speaker Jargba.flavor_text: A wand wound with a lock of someone's hair. It's best not to ask whose.

Death Speaker Jargba.name: Death's Head Hauberk
Death Speaker Jargba.flavor_text: Mail sewn over a quilboar-skull gorget. It settles on the shoulders like a hand.

Death Speaker Jargba.name: Hexbinder's Mace
Death Speaker Jargba.flavor_text: A bone-capped mace, carved with the names of those who stopped arguing.

Overlord Ramtusk.name: Ramtusk's Tusk-Crown
Overlord Ramtusk.flavor_text: A great helm with a pair of real tusks. It rings like a bell when you are struck.

Overlord Ramtusk.name: Overlord's Warcleaver
Overlord Ramtusk.flavor_text: A two-handed axe made for a boar-lord. It's heavy, and it makes up its own mind about direction.

Overlord Ramtusk.name: Boarlord's Girdle
Overlord Ramtusk.flavor_text: A belt of cured hide, scarred where something bit it. The scars are, so far, mostly decorative.

Overlord Ramtusk.name: Pen-Keeper's Longrifle
Overlord Ramtusk.flavor_text: A long rifle that Ramtusk's pen-keepers used on escapees. It has opinions about range.

Agathelos the Raging.name: Agathelos's Rending Fang
Agathelos the Raging.flavor_text: A fang the length of a forearm, mounted on a bone grip. It tears more than it cuts.

Agathelos the Raging.name: Beastpit Hide Jerkin
Agathelos the Raging.flavor_text: The cured pelt of something that did not like its keepers. It does not particularly like you, either.

Agathelos the Raging.name: Raging Pelt Cloak
Agathelos the Raging.flavor_text: A fur cloak, matted with dried blood. It warms you, and it makes you irritable.

Agathelos the Raging.name: Chainbound Legguards
Agathelos the Raging.flavor_text: Mail legguards with a broken manacle still hanging from one knee. It rings a little, in a way that feels sarcastic.

Charlga Razorflank.name: Razorflank's Heartstaff
Charlga Razorflank.flavor_text: A staff of sunbaked thorn with a pulsing heartwood knot. Wounds close faster around it, and quietly.

Charlga Razorflank.name: Thorn-Crown of Agamaggan
Charlga Razorflank.flavor_text: A circlet of interlaced thorn, old as the hill. The spirits of the boar-god lean in when you wear it.

Charlga Razorflank.name: Chieftain's Thornplate Legs
Charlga Razorflank.flavor_text: Plate grown through with living briar. It hurts to be hit, and it hurts to hit it.

Charlga Razorflank.name: Thornfang Longsword
Charlga Razorflank.flavor_text: A long blade with a sawtooth edge, traded for the lives of three of Charlga's guards.

Blind Hunter.name: Blind Hunter's Shortbow
Blind Hunter.flavor_text: A bow strung with sinew. It was built for someone who had to listen for the target.

Blind Hunter.name: Listener's Leather Gloves
Blind Hunter.flavor_text: Soft leather gloves, cut to feel the pull of a string. They are very quiet.

Blind Hunter.name: Hunter's Bone Signet
Blind Hunter.flavor_text: A ring of carved bone. It doesn't have eyes, but it seems to be looking.

Earthcaller Halmgar.name: Earthcaller's Mantle
Earthcaller Halmgar.flavor_text: A mantle of woven root. It hums, faintly, with the pitch of a buried stone.

Earthcaller Halmgar.name: Halmgar's Stoneclaw Mace
Earthcaller Halmgar.flavor_text: A mace topped with a smooth grey stone. When you swing it, the ground notices.

Earthcaller Halmgar.name: Pendant of the Deep Root
Earthcaller Halmgar.flavor_text: A pendant of petrified root. It is heavier than it looks, and much calmer.

Earthcaller Halmgar.name: Kraul Burrow-Claws
Earthcaller Halmgar.flavor_text: Made for digging. Repurposed without modification.
Earthcaller Halmgar.label: Fist (Str)

Thornjaw the Gorger.name: Thornjaw's Gorge-Cap
Thornjaw the Gorger.flavor_text: A helm cured from a sow's skull, thorns left in. It makes you feel hungry and a little ridiculous.

Thornjaw the Gorger.name: Gorger's Claw-Knuckles
Thornjaw the Gorger.flavor_text: Claws set in a fist-bar of bone. It bites at the end of a punch.

Thornjaw the Gorger.name: Wallow-Mud Band
Thornjaw the Gorger.flavor_text: A ring of baked mud and bone. It's gross, and it fits perfectly.

Thornjaw the Gorger.name: Rootfang Spine
Thornjaw the Gorger.flavor_text: Pulled from something larger and thrown at something larger still.
Thornjaw the Gorger.label: Thrown (Agi)
